title: In-browser MOBA Mercenaries of Tezigdal which aims to add novel features and mechanics that I've never seen implemented in the MOBA genre before.
author: ADIRTYHOBO59
selftext:
[https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/](https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/)

This is a recent changelog entry:

Changelog Updated!

0.2.507 - 2026-10-12

* Now introducing Implements and Faculties to Pilfered Plains
* Implements — Work together with your team to construct powerful upgrades that fortify your base and unlock new strategic capabilities.
* Faculties — Disable base functions to boost your passive gold income, trading utility and defense for greater economic power.
* Rejuvenation I, II & III — Upgrade your Monoliths to gradually restore their health and eventually grant them the ability to respawn after being destroyed.
* Lane Bolstering — Enabled by default, Lane Bolstering ensures regular Golem wave spawns and strengthens Monolith defenses at the cost of reduced passive gold generation.

Here's a link to a playthrough if anyone would like to see some gameplay. I would absolutely love feedback if anyone gets to check it out!

[https://youtu.be/XiFIkN9rc-U?is=eAk5vmqSPtlXACSx](https://youtu.be/XiFIkN9rc-U?is=eAk5vmqSPtlXACSx)
